name: Erzsebet Alternata
original_name: エルジェーベト・アルタナータ
source:
The haughty bishop of the Magic Department, and a very powerful mage. He's the one who invited [url=https://vndb.org/c103282]Belial[/url] to join the temple and got him into an arranged marriage with [url=https://vndb.org/c103278]Arne[/url], his niece. This makes him the current lead of the House of Alternata.

Don't let his looks fool you - he actually turned forty-five this year. Erzsebet apparently traded his physical growth for the sake of higher levels of magic, and is notably able to float at will.
